summary: No blocking defect found: the row builder reproduces the committed file byte for byte, every stored fuzz count and the guard-on-recorded-topology result re-run identically, 12 live rig replays match the stored numbers, and my own neighbouring probes (cylinder rim near the radius at R 0.5 to 2000, huge and tiny box scales, bevel after side and top holes) all stayed inside the guard or were caught by the face-count post-check. Only minor evidence and wording gaps remain; the live contract path (browser) could not be replayed here because no playwright-cli or browser exists on this box.

defects.feature: row 66 (round then hollow, smaller radius) and row 46 (union edge)
defects.problem: Evidence names only brep-rs as the second oracle (OCCT refuses). I derived the closed form for row 66 (14400-6.4379-9360 = 5033.5621 vs truck 5033.5577, 8.7e-7) and it agrees, but the row text does not state it; row 46 face count (9 vs OCCT 14/15) is explained only by brep-rs agreement.
refusalSentence says 'was turned' but the row also covers move(), whose own evidence quotes a different sentence ('already changed by an earlier move').
Row carries the contract wording but its TODAY page text ('a solidcraft command list has no second copy') uses engine words; no TODAY/CONTRACT split as elsewhere.

defects.feature: rows 0, 1, 74-77 (curved volume bar 3e-4 of total volume)
defects.problem: 17 of 301 curved contract builds with an oracle have a blend effect below the bar (tiny sizes, rim r0.5), so volume cannot see them; only the face count backs those. A tiny-radius error on a curved body would pass.
status wrong (chamfer-style primitive round silently reopens as a fillet) is honest but has no CONTRACT row and no refusal at save time.

The kernel's no-chamfer failure is scale dependent: a single chamfer 0.05 on a 2000x1500x1000 box builds 6 faces (no chamfer) although 0.01 works on 40x30x20. Caught only by postCheck (face count), which applies to single planar edges, not to rims or groups; groups and rims tested fine at that scale in my probe.

notMeasured: Live contract path (browser, fc-host + fc-live): not replayed, no playwright-cli or browser on this box; replayed the guard on recorded real topology instead (identical).

Guard on topology of new cases (e.g. a hole that breaks through the front face: raw kernel is 0.7 to 4.1 percent wrong there, the guard rules R1/R4 should refuse it but I could not produce truck topology for it).
Fillet-at-huge-scale single-edge post-check path, grouped-chamfer tiny sizes on huge parts beyond one case.
